parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

💡
acquire[əkwaiər]v.
To acquire something is to gain possession of it.
→ Tina acquired a strange package yesterday.
💡
awkward[ɔ:kwərd]adj.
If something is awkward, it is embarrassing and uncomfortable.
→ After dropping his coffee cup, Robbie felt awkward.
💡
caretaker[kɛərtəikər]n.
A caretaker is a person who takes care of very young, old, or sick people.
→ My grandmother's caretaker helps her get around the house.
💡
deceive[disi:v]v.
To deceive someone is to make them believe something that is not true.
→ He tried to deceive his friends as they were playing a game.
💡
discourage[diskə:ridʒ]v.
To discourage someone is to make them feel less excited about something.
→ Mr. Perry discouraged the students from quitting school.
💡
fake[feik]adj.
If something is fake, it is made to look real in order to trick people.
→ The model was wearing fake eyelashes.
💡
hatred[heitrid]n.
Hatred is a strong feeling of not liking someone or something.
→ I have a hatred for the taste of medicine.
💡
hut[hʌt]n.
A hut is a house made of wood, grass, or mud that has only one or two rooms.
→ We all went into the hut to sleep.
💡
inferior[infiəriər]adj.
If something is inferior, it is not as good as something else.
→ Cars built a hundred years ago are inferior to ones built today.
💡
lodge[lɑdʒ]n.
A lodge is a house in the mountains, used by people who hunt or fish.
→ During our ski trip, we stayed at a lodge.
💡
neglect[niglekt]v.
To neglect someone or something is to not take care of it properly.
→ William neglected his room, so it is a complete mess.
💡
newcomer[nju:kʌmər]n.
A newcomer is a person who has recently arrived at a place or a group.
→ The students happily welcomed the newcomer to the school.
💡
offense[əfens]n.
An offense is behavior that is wrong or breaks a law.
→ Stealing a car is a very serious offense.
💡
overlook[ouvərluk]v.
To overlook something is to not notice it, or to not realize that it is important.
→ Brenda overlooked the last step and had a bad fall.
💡
repay[ripei]v.
To repay is to pay back or to reward someone or something.
→ She repaid her friend for all of his hard work with a small gift.
💡
ridiculous[ridikjələs]adj.
If something is ridiculous, it is silly or strange.
→ Steve looked ridiculous with those huge blue sunglasses.
💡
satisfactory[sætisfæktəri]adj.
If something is satisfactory, it is good enough.
→ Mina often received satisfactory grades since she studied so hard.
💡
shepherd[ʃepərd]n.
A shepherd is a person who protects and cares for sheep.
→ The shepherd moved the sheep to another field.
💡
venture[ventʃər]v.
To venture is to go to a place that may be dangerous.
→ Even though it was dangerous, they ventured up the mountain.
💡
wheat[hwi:t]n.
Wheat is a plant which makes grain. Wheat grain is used to make bread.
→ The field of golden wheat was ready to be harvested.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Part A. Choose the right word for the given definition.

questions.content: a strong feeling of not liking someone or something
questions.explanation: Hatred means a strong feeling of dislike (sự căm ghét).

questions.content: not as good as
questions.explanation: Inferior means not as good as something else (thấp kém hơn).

questions.content: to get something
questions.explanation: To acquire is to get or gain possession of something (đạt được, giành được).

questions.content: to go to a dangerous place
questions.explanation: To venture is to go to a place that may be dangerous (liều lĩnh đi vào).

questions.content: a plant that makes grain
questions.explanation: Wheat is a plant used to make grain (lúa mì).

sections.title: Exercise 1: Part B. Choose the right definition for the given word.

questions.content: satisfactory
questions.explanation: Satisfactory means good enough (vừa ý, thỏa đáng).

questions.content: newcomer
questions.explanation: A newcomer is a person who has recently arrived (người mới đến).

questions.content: repay
options: a bad thing that someone does
questions.explanation: To repay means to give back or reward (trả đền, báo đáp).

questions.content: fake
questions.explanation: Fake means not real (giả mạo).

questions.content: discouraged
questions.explanation: Discouraged means made to feel less excited or confident (bị làm nản lòng).

sections.title: Exercise 2: Circle two words that are related in each group.

questions.content: a. discourage b. lodge c. venture d. hut
questions.explanation: Lodge và hut đều chỉ các loại nhà gỗ, lều nhỏ.

questions.content: a. shepherd b. caretaker c. repay d. wheat
questions.explanation: Shepherd và caretaker đều chỉ người chăm sóc, trông nom.

questions.content: a. offense b. fake c. hatred d. deceive
questions.explanation: Fake (giả) và deceive (lừa dối) có ý nghĩa liên quan đến sự dối trá.

questions.content: a. acquire b. awkward c. newcomer d. ridiculous
questions.explanation: Awkward (kỳ cục) và ridiculous (nực cười) có nghĩa gần giống nhau.

questions.content: a. overlook b. inferior c. neglect d. satisfactory
questions.explanation: Overlook (bỏ qua) và neglect (bỏ bê) đều liên quan đến sự thiếu chú ý.

sections.title: Exercise 3: Choose the word that is the better fit for each blank.

questions.content: The girl didn't like the ________, so she played a joke on them. She put ________ bugs in their drinks. (fake / newcomers)
questions.explanation: newcomers (người mới đến) và fake (giả mạo).

questions.content: Dave hoped to ________ a new house. The ________ where he lived was too old. (acquire / lodge)
questions.explanation: acquire (sở hữu) và lodge (căn nhà gỗ).

questions.content: She was eager to ________ the boy that had helped her repair her bike. While others had simply ________ her, he was happy to help. (repay / neglected)
questions.explanation: repay (đền đáp) và neglected (bỏ mặc).

questions.content: Going to jail ________ the man from any ________ in the future. (offenses / discouraged)
questions.explanation: discouraged (làm nản lòng) và offenses (hành vi vi phạm).

questions.content: In the middle of the storm, the ________ looked for his lost sheep by ________ up the mountain. (shepherd / venturing)
questions.explanation: shepherd (người chăn cừu) và venturing (đánh liều, đi đến nơi nguy hiểm).

questions.content: My little brother tried to ________ us by dressing in Dad's clothes, but he just looked ________. (deceive / ridiculous)
questions.explanation: deceive (lừa phỉnh) và ridiculous (nực cười).

questions.content: The farmer built his ________ close to the ________ field so he could constantly watch it. (wheat / hut)
questions.explanation: hut (túp lều) và wheat (lúa mì).

questions.content: After the ________ started a small fire in the kitchen, he felt very ________. (awkward / caretaker)
questions.explanation: caretaker (người trông nom) và awkward (lúng túng, bối rối).

questions.content: Most shoppers tend to ________ any products that they think are ________ to similar things. (overlook / inferior)
questions.explanation: overlook (bỏ qua) và inferior (kém chất lượng hơn).

questions.content: She had a ________ for food with tomatoes, but everything else on the menu was ________. (hatred / satisfactory)
questions.explanation: hatred (sự căm ghét) và satisfactory (đủ tốt, thỏa đáng).

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The Shepherd and the Wild Sheep

Once there was a shepherd. Every night he counted and gathered his sheep. He was sure never to overlook any of them. One night, he saw some wild sheep had joined his herd. He hoped to acquire the newcomers.

It snowed that night. In the morning, the shepherd couldn't take his sheep out of his lodge. Instead, he had to feed them inside. He gave a small amount of wheat to his own sheep. But he gave more of the food to the wild sheep. He thought the extra wheat would discourage them from leaving.

It snowed for several days. During that time, the shepherd's sheep ate very little. The wild sheep, however, ate very well.

At last, the snow melted, and they ventured outdoors. As soon as he opened the door of his hut, the wild sheep started to run away.

"Wait! This is how you repay me? After I treated you so kindly, why do you run away?" the shepherd asked. His voice was full of hatred.

The wild sheep stopped and turned toward the shepherd.

"We're leaving because you fed us better than your own sheep," one of the wild sheep replied. "You tried to deceive us with your ridiculous plan. Yesterday you treated us kindly, but tomorrow you might be different. If more wild sheep joined your herd, you would treat us as inferior sheep."

As the wild sheep ran away, the shepherd understood his offense. He knew this awkward situation was his own fault. He had not been a satisfactory caretaker. He was a fake friend to the wild sheep. Because of this, he had neglected his own herd.

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement T for true or F for false.

questions.content: The shepherd counted his sheep because he didn't want to overlook any of them.
questions.explanation: Câu văn trong bài là "He was sure never to overlook any of them." (Ông ấy chắc chắn không bao giờ bỏ sót bất kỳ con nào trong số chúng). Việc đếm cừu giúp ông ấy không bỏ sót. Do đó câu này là Đúng (True).

questions.content: The shepherd couldn't take the sheep outside because it was dark outside.
questions.explanation: Bài đọc nói rằng "It snowed that night. In the morning, the shepherd couldn't take his sheep out of his lodge." (Đêm đó trời có tuyết. Buổi sáng, người chăn cừu không thể đưa những con cừu của mình ra khỏi nhà). Lý do là vì trời có tuyết, chứ không phải vì trời tối. Do vậy câu này là Sai (False).

questions.content: The shepherd gave a little wheat to the wild sheep. But he gave his own sheep more.
questions.explanation: Trong bài có nói "He gave a small amount of wheat to his own sheep. But he gave more of the food to the wild sheep." (Ông ấy chỉ cho bầy cừu của mình một lượng nhỏ lúa mì. Nhưng ông ấy lại cho bầy cừu hoang nhiều thức ăn hơn). Câu hỏi viết ngược lại, nên câu này là Sai (False).

questions.content: The wild sheep ran away from the shepherd after the snow melted.
questions.explanation: Cùng xem câu "At last, the snow melted, and they ventured outdoors. As soon as he opened the door of his hut, the wild sheep started to run away." (Cuối cùng, tuyết tan, và họ bước ra ngoài. Ngay khi ông mở cửa túp lều, những con cừu hoang đã bắt đầu bỏ chạy). Điều này hoàn toàn khớp, nên đáp án là Đúng (True).

questions.content: The wild sheep thought the shepherd had neglected his own sheep.
questions.explanation: Con cừu hoang đã nói "Yesterday you treated us kindly, but tomorrow you might be different. If more wild sheep joined your herd, you would treat us as inferior sheep." (Hôm qua ông đối xử tốt với chúng tôi, nhưng ngày mai ông có thể sẽ khác. Nếu có thêm nhiều cừu hoang gia nhập đàn, ông sẽ coi chúng tôi là những con cừu thấp kém). Hành động đối xử bất công đã chứng tỏ sự bỏ bê của người chăn cừu đối với bầy cừu của chính mình. Đáp án là Đúng (True).

questions.content: The shepherd never knew what he had done wrong.
questions.explanation: Đoạn cuối bài viết "As the wild sheep ran away, the shepherd understood his offense." (Khi những con cừu hoang bỏ chạy, người chăn cừu đã hiểu ra lỗi lầm của mình). Như vậy ông ấy biết mình làm sai điều gì. Câu này là Sai (False).

questions.content: What was the shepherd's hope for the wild sheep?
options: That they would feel hatred for him
questions.explanation: Câu đầu bài viết "He hoped to acquire the newcomers." (Ông ấy hy vọng có thể thu nạp được những thành viên mới này). Vậy ông ấy muốn có được bầy cừu hoang. Đáp án đúng là That he could acquire them.

questions.content: How did the shepherd hope to discourage the wild sheep from running away?
options: By locking them in his hut
questions.explanation: Bài đọc giải thích "He thought the extra wheat would discourage them from leaving." (Ông ấy nghĩ rằng việc cho thêm lúa mì sẽ làm chúng nản lòng mà không rời đi). Vậy ông ấy dùng thêm thức ăn (extra food) để giữ chúng lại.

questions.content: All of the following describe what kind of caretaker the shepherd was EXCEPT__
questions.explanation: Ở đoạn cuối, tác giả kết luận "He had not been a satisfactory caretaker. He was a fake friend to the wild sheep." (Ông ấy không phải là một người chăm sóc tốt. Ông ấy là một người bạn giả tạo đối với bầy cừu hoang). Do đó, từ KHÔNG mô tả ông ta là satisfactory (đáng hài lòng, tốt).

questions.content: What was the shepherd's offense?
options: He never acquired the wild sheep.
He trapped the sheep in his lodge.
He did not care for his own sheep.
questions.explanation: Câu chốt của bài là "Because of this, he had neglected his own herd." (Chính vì điều này, ông ấy đã bỏ bê bầy cừu của mình). Đó chính là lỗi lầm lớn nhất của ông ấy. Đáp án đúng là He did not care for his own sheep.
